canonical_project: Henan Airport Intelligent Computing Center (河南空港智算中心)
owner: Henan Airport Digital City Development & Construction Co (河南空港数字城市开发建设有限公司)
notes: Central-China's largest intelligent-computing center, at Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone (豫发锦荣信息科技园), two machine-room buildings / 16 modular rooms; Phase 1 planned 30,000P; first 2,000P live Oct 2024; officially 投产 Jan 2025 (CCTV河南总站 reports). Compute in P-flops; MW not published.
